summary: Clarify staged research use and maintenance scope; offer a compact study-note experience carrier while retaining strict templates and runtime contracts.

core/QUICKSTART.md: Prepare a question or a review
core/docs/methods/README.md: Choose a guide by research question

revisit: Choose only currently relevant reading and the experience carrier. Retain old frozen/selected structured contracts; a new carrier does not relabel old records.
acceptance: Three entry walkthroughs and original-template/runtime preservation are checked separately; scientific review, required actual execution and first-delivery preservation remain. No measured efficiency or causal model benefit is asserted.

design_inputs.scope: Observed semantic carrier use and scoped review loop, not strict-v1 format or architecture-effect validation

invariants: No original guides, records, paths, templates, runtime or schemas deleted.
Strict v1 fields and strict entry/plan/Run consumers remain unchanged.
Single-owner note is ordinary file evidence; parallel/structured contracts use original formal route.
First deliveries and scoped historical verdicts preserved.
Researcher path does not inherit the whole maintainer publication ledger.
effect_status: Compact route is a new documented option; quantitative cost and model effects remain unmeasured.
